content.title: Is Easter Monday a holiday? Not in the U.S.
content.text: Globally, Easter Monday is observed by most countries, but in the United States, its status remains a source of annual confusion.Easter Monday, observed the day after Easter, is recognized by Christians across the globe and is a public holiday in many countries, including Canada, the United Kingdom and much of Europe.In the United States, some schools and employers may choose to close for the day, but it is on an individual case-by-case basis, not a set standard.Here's what to know about Easter Monday in the United States.Is Easter Monday a federal holiday?No. Easter Monday is not recognized as a federal holiday.Are banks open on Easter Monday?Yes, banks will be open on Easter Monday, April 6, 2026.Is the post office open? Is there mail delivery on Easter Monday?Since Easter Monday is not a public holiday, there will be mail delivery and U.S. Postal Service post offices will be open Monday, April 6.What is Easter Monday?Easter Monday celebrates the day after Jesus Christ's resurrection. According to History, several countries observe Easter Monday as a public holiday.In the third or fourth century, Christians began extending the Easter celebration, which originally ended on Easter Sunday, to eight days, per History.Easter Monday is known by various other names, including:Bright MondayRenewal MondayLittle EasterMonday of the AngelsWhat is the Easter Monday Act?The Easter Monday Act of 2025 is a bill to amend title 5 of the United States Code to designate Easter Monday as a legal public holiday.The bill, sponsored by Sen. Eric Schmitt (R-Missouri) was introduced in the U.S. Senate on April 10, 2025, and referred to the Senate Judiciary Committee, where it still sits.A related House bill, H.R. 2951, also named Easter Monday Act of 2025, introduced April 17, 2025, by Rep. Riley Moore (R-West Virginia) was referred to House Oversight and Government Reform Committee, where no action has yet been taken.Jordan Green covers trending news for The Commercial Appeal and Tennessee. She can be reached at jordan.green@commercialappeal.com.This article originally appeared on Memphis Commercial Appeal: Is Easter Monday a holiday? are banks open? What to know
